notes.title: MONSTER UPDATE! 👻🦟
notes.notes:
🎣 Voodoo Fishin’ with a Monster Update!
Evenin’, swampfolk! we’ve got a fresh batch of updates cooked up for the bayou!
Thanks again for all the feedback during Fishing Fest – it’s been awesome watching everyone reel in fish, find bugs (the code kind… and now the skeeter kind 👀), and make the swamp feel alive.

Here’s what’s new in this patch:
[hr][/hr]👾 Monsters & World
🦟 Mosquitoes have arrived – the swamp just got dangerous.

👻 Beware of what lies in the far reaches of the bayou…

🗺️ Map edits: outhouse zone, voodoo spot, collision/jump fixes, new fishing areas.

🚧 Several sections are now gated off in prep for the final demo version.
[hr][/hr]🛠 Gameplay & Systems
🔄 Host migration – sessions will now persist if the host leaves or drops.

🎣 Fishing: you can now move (slowly) while your line is in the water, plus networked fishing lines so your crew sees the tug!

🗑 Junk catches added – worthless (for now 👀) but will matter in a future mechanic.

🐟 Throwing your catch & junk – physics-based tossing. Don’t bean your buddies too hard!
[hr][/hr]🧊 Coolers
🏃 Movement nerf: no more sprinting with a cooler.

⚙️ Coolers now have a proper animation movement set.

🎨 Custom Cooler Colors – choose your cooler look in the Puppet Creator!
[hr][/hr]🛍 Shops & NPCs
🎣 New Tackle Shop visuals.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Pierre (Tackleshop) and Caesar (Fish Monger) have joined the swamp!
[hr][/hr]🧵 Puppets
Puppet updates (better normals and a couple new items to further customize yourself)
[hr][/hr]
We’ll keep tuning based on your playtests and feedback. Grab your buddies, hop in, and let us know how it feels!


Tight lines and spooky vibes,
The Lost Arcade Crew 🕹️

notes.title: Final Demo Update! Play till July 8th.
notes.notes:
🎣 Demo Wrap-Up & What’s Next for Voodoo Fishin’

A huge thank you to everyone who played the demo over the past few weeks! We were absolutely blown away by the number of players during Steam’s Fishing Fest. Seeing so many of you exploring the world, crafting crazy puppets, and reeling in big catches was a dream come true for our tiny team of three.

Thanks to your feedback, bug reports, and thoughtful comments, we’ve gathered a ton of insight that’s already helping us shape the next phase of the game. Our goal has always been to make Voodoo Fishin’ one of the best (and weirdest) fishing games you’ve ever played—and you’ve helped us get that much closer.

🐟 Fresh Updates: 

HUGE refactor of fish movement! Fish now stay within the water boundaries (yes, even in those tiny little fishing holes), and movement is now fully physics-based for better realism and better fights. 

Daily Specials at the Fish Monger - Prices are updated daily at UTC+9h. Happy hunting!

New Fish Caught UI -  replacing one of the final pieces of our early placeholder interface with something much more tactile and hand-crafted. 

While fighting fish, players will now rotate when the fish move too far to the left or the right.

Fixed a bug where the rod would snap to the right on your first cast.

📅 The Demo is Sunsetting July 8th
We’ll be wrapping up this version of the demo next week so we can shift focus to the next wave of features. We’ve got a lot of cool stuff coming—and we want your help testing it!

🚨 Join the Steam Playtests via Discord!
We’re moving to the Steam Playtest platform to test new features, balance changes, and spooky surprises before launch. Playtest access will be managed through our Discord—so if you want in, come hang out!
👉 https://discord.gg/cGRUrKgter

Thank you again for fishing with us. We’re just getting started, and we can’t wait to show you what’s next.

Tight lines and spooky vibes!
—The Voodoo Fishin’ Team 🎣👻

notes.title: Post Fishing Fest Update
notes.notes:
🎣 Attention puppet anglers 🎣

That Fishing Fest was wild—lobbies packed, rods bent, friends yelling “SET THE HOOK!” at midnight... Thanks for jumping in, breaking things, and telling us what rocked (and still needs polish). Your streams, feedback, and bug reports are already shaping the next build—and we’ll keep at it to crank out fixes.

Now onto the patch notes:

Fish are now networked for 3rd Person! - Players will now see the fish their buddies are fighting before they are caught.



We've added some fun animation around the tutorial signage to help explain casting controls better:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579176/b6b6435a554c0007953ab7fad41eb0cdb05585e3.gif"]



In Options, Casting Direction now has two toggle options: Left/Right and Forward/Back.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45579176/4f83e65422ff65171c86700b46aff8b717d027d0.jpg"]



Fixed a Camera bug where Casting while looking up or down left the position in an awkward state.  Players should have a much better view of the end of the rod for Hook Set, and no longer see the top of the torso at a strange angle. Get out there and fish from those high-spots :)



Fix for FullScreen toggle resetting in Options



Fix for Clients where camera was not tracking the bait as they cast.


Pressing E for exiting Tackle shop and Fish Monger is quick-press instead of a hold.


Fixed double splash noise bug on casting



Thanks again! and see you on the docks!

notes.title: Demo Patch #3
notes.notes:
Big Performance Update

This update includes major performance improvements and smoother gameplay—especially when casting!

Tackle Shop Improvements

Re-roll your options: Don’t like what’s in stock? Pay a small fee to refresh the available gear in each category.

Auto-Restock: Trays that sell out will now restock over time. No more empty shelves!

Bait Balancing

Bait Size is now more closely tied to Bait Quality. Higher-quality bait is now required to catch larger fish. This system will continue to evolve with future updates.

Map Update

The cave area has expanded! The question is: can you find it?

notes.title: Voodoo Fishin': Patch #2
notes.notes:
Look Sensitivity now has two sliders, X and Y.

Hookset now has better fail logic, along with visual messaging.

New random, flavored Linebreak fly-text.

Updated Casting tutorial text (Updated tutorial on the way!)

Level collision updates/fixes.

Fish rarity and value balancing.

auto-unequip fishing pole before entering tackleshop and other no fishing zones.



The next patch is already in the works.  Keep fishing and sending us your comments and we'll keep iterating. Tight lines and spooky vibes!
